models_evaluated: eight contemporary LLMs (zero- and five-shot, unnamed in text)

links.outcome: Share of reference answers judged contestable by expert validation
links.effect: 6-10% of reference answers were found contestable by experts, indicating imperfect ground truth in the benchmark.
links.quote: Answers are free-form clinical prose rather than extractive spans, and an expert validation study finds 6-10% of reference answers contestable.

unlisted_practices: LLM-as-judge rubric calibrated against expert raters (found unreliable on clinical safety)
Creating expert-curated non-English clinical QA benchmark datasets

screen.reason: The paper introduces IndoNutriQA, an Indonesian clinical nutrition question-answering benchmark dataset, and evaluates multiple LLMs and LLM-as-a-judge rubrics. It does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
